transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

My wife wanted me to talk to someone. She... well, we've been having some disagreements lately. She says I'm overthinking things. 

It's just... she's been having these late meetings. And I've noticed little changes in her work messages. She tells me it's just normal office stuff, but... I don't know. For the past year, it's all lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It's like there’s a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t say directly. 

So... she wanted me to come here. That's really it.
Have you had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I sleep... fine. I mean, I get tired just like anyone else. I don't really see what that has to do with anything.
Do you think your wife is intentionally sending these messages to communicate a hidden threat or message specifically to you?

I... I don't know about a threat. That's your word. But... like I just said, it's not an accident. 

I know she claims it's all just normal office stuff, but... when things line up that precisely for an entire year, you notice. It means something. It's... it's a private signal. Just... a way of telling me things she refuses to just say to my face.
Have you started any new medications, drugs, or supplements before this began?
No. I haven't started any new medications. I don't... I don't take anything like that.
Have you ever heard voices that other people do not hear?
No. I don't hear voices. It's just... the messages. That's all.
Have you had trouble keeping your thoughts organized or speaking in a way that others say is hard to follow?
No. My thoughts are fine. Nobody has ever told me I'm hard to follow.
Do you ever feel like strangers, coworkers, or the media are sending you hidden messages or signals meant specifically for you?

Not strangers, no. Or the media. Just... well, my wife. She says her late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but... I don't know. For the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It's like... like there’s a private signal in them. Something meant to tell me what she won’t just say directly.
Have you had any other beliefs that people would say are unusual or not based in reality?
No. I don't... no. Nothing like that. I'm just trying to understand what she's doing. I don't have any other... unusual ideas, if that's what you mean. Everything else is just normal.
How certain are you that your wife is sending you hidden messages through her work communications?

I'm... certain. I know she says the late meetings and... the little changes in her messages are just normal office stuff. But... it's been a year. They’ve just lined up too precisely to be an accident. It’s a private signal. She's just... trying to tell me something she won’t say directly. I just know what I'm seeing.
Have you had any times when you felt unusually depressed or unusually high or irritable at the same time as these beliefs?
No. I haven't. I just... I go to work, I come home. My mood is fine. I'm just dealing with... with what's happening with her. That's all.
Have you recently had any head injury, confusion, or memory problems?
No. I haven't hit my head. My memory is... it's fine. I'm not confused.
How long have you been believing that your wife is sending you hidden messages?
Like I said... about a year. It started right around when she went back to working outside the home again.
Have you ever had a period of several days when you felt abnormally high, irritable, or full of energy?
No. I... I think you already asked me about that. My mood hasn't changed. I'm just... normal.
Have you ever believed that your thoughts were being inserted into your mind, taken out of your mind, or broadcast so that other people could hear them?
No. I... I don't know what you mean by that. My thoughts are just mine. Nobody is doing anything to them.
Have you ever had a seizure?
No. Never.
Have you ever believed that your wife was unfaithful to you?

I... I don't know if I would use that exact word. But... well, for the past year, things haven't really added up. 

She tells me her late meetings and... the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But I... I don't know. They line up too precisely to just be an accident. It feels more like... like there’s some kind of private signal in them. Like they're meant to tell me something she just won’t say directly.
Have these beliefs caused problems for you at work, at home, or in your relationships?

Not at work, no. I... I still show up for my teaching sections just fine. Keep up with the data analysis. I still ride my bike, meet up with friends for chess. It doesn't affect any of that. 

It's mostly just... well, at home. We just get stuck in these arguments. About her schedule, and... what it really means. That's the main place it causes any trouble, I guess.
Have you ever believed that your wife was actually spying on you or trying to poison or harm you?
No... no, nothing like that. Spying or... harming me? No. It's just the messages. That's all.
